shellCommands.command: cat package.json && git diff package.json && ls -a && cat app/page.tsx lib/api* next.config.* 2>/dev/null; ls app lib; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

grep -n "cacheLife\|cacheTag\|unstable_cache" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts; grep -rn "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head; ls __agent_eval__; cat app/layout.tsx tsconfig.json
sed -n 75,92p node_modules/next/cache.d.ts; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20
